newsitem.title: USA: TCF Financial applies for bank charters.
newsitem.headline: TCF Financial applies for bank charters.

text.p: TCF Financial Corp said on Monday that it applied to the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency to convert its federal savings bank subsidiaries to national banks.
TCF said it currently has four savings bank subsidiaries in 194 locations.

"TCF has already made the transformation to a community bank by focusing for the past 10 years on higher-yielding consumer and small commercial loans and lower interest-cost deposit accounts," chief executive officer William Cooper said in a news release. "Recently enacted legislation clears the way for us to convert to bank charters and be recognized for what we already are: a top-performing community bank."
Shares of TCF, a $7.1 billion asset financial holding company rose 5/8 to 41-1/4 Monday.
